source: Actual Unreal DX11 GPU depth frame from the four-way pallet fixture, after configured range/noise/quantization/dropout and latency. Captured in CampusFoundation-Vision2.log. No actor ID or pose is included in the detector input.

format.type: float32 little endian optical Z metres
uint8 validity: 0 valid, 1 no-return, 2 too-close, 3 too-far, 4 dropout

assertion_scope: Distance is test-fixture truth used only by the regression assertion, never recognition input. Family dimensions are calibrated geometric priors.
